title: Conditional Generation of Creative Chess Puzzles with Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.38577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While modern language models demonstrate impressive generative capabilities, they often struggle with constrained, counter-intuitive creative tasks. To address this limitation, we explore chess puzzle generation as a rigorous testbed for computational creativity and reasoning, a domain where altering a single piece can invalidate an entire solution. We propose a novel approach for conditional generation of creative chess puzzles using masked diffusion models. Unlike previous methods, our non-directional diffusion approach allows for conditioning on specific tactical themes and partial board positions. We introduce a novel auxiliary task of simultaneous best-move prediction, which improves solution uniqueness by 11.6% and theme-conditioning accuracy by 2.5%. translated_title: 基于扩散模型的创意国际象棋谜题条件生成
translated_abstract: 尽管现代语言模型展现出令人印象深刻的生成能力，但它们在受约束的、反直觉的创造性任务上常常表现不佳。为了解决这一局限，我们探索将国际象棋谜题生成作为计算创造力与推理的严格测试平台——在这个领域中，改变单个棋子就可能使整个解失效。我们提出了一种使用掩码扩散模型进行创意国际象棋谜题条件生成的新方法。与以往方法不同，我们的非定向扩散方法允许以特定战术主题和部分棋盘局面作为条件。我们引入了一项新颖的辅助任务——同步最佳着法预测，该任务将解的唯一性提高了11.6%，并将主题条件的准确率提高了2.5%。为了进一步优化解的唯一性和主题条件化，我们建立了一个改编自去噪扩散策略优化（DDPO）的强化学习框架。
tldr: 提出一种基于掩码扩散模型的国际象棋谜题条件生成方法，通过同步最佳着法预测辅助任务和基于DDPO的强化学习框架，显著提升了谜题解的唯一性与主题条件的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a masked diffusion model approach for conditional generation of creative chess puzzles, which, combined with a novel simultaneous best-move prediction auxiliary task and a DDPO-based reinforcement learning framework, significantly improves solution uniqueness and theme-conditioning accuracy.
